Character Profile
Ciko
Grajaú, São Paulo · SP

Ciko is a stocky, barrel-chested capybara from Grajaú, one of São Paulo's sprawling southern neighbourhoods, he carries the neighbourhood in his posture, wide stance, unhurried, unbothered. Growing up on the city's rougher side taught him two things: confidence and hustle. Nobody knows exactly how he made his fortune, and nobody is impolite enough to ask how a rodent from Grajaú, orbits the champagne terraces of Itaim Bibi.

Today he spends most afternoons drifting between the cafés, rooftop bars, luxury gyms and members' clubs of Itaim Bibi, where he's become a familiar face among footballers, influencers, startup founders, rappers and television personalities. He's never the loudest person in the room, yet somehow every VIP host knows his name.

Some say he owns businesses. Some say he invests in startups. Some say he knows everybody. Ciko simply smiles.

Appearance

The Look

Standing just over four feet tall, Ciko has the unmistakable relaxed expression only a capybara can pull off. Ciko's wardrobe lives in the tension between streetwear and new money. He favours open-collar shirts in cream, beige, or the green-and-gold of the Seleção, always worn slightly too tight across his substantial frame. His signature accessories are non-negotiable.

His trademark look includes: oversized 24k gold Cuban link chains, a heavy custom medallion featuring his own capybara insignia, a solid gold Audemars Piguet Royal Oak watch, a chunky gold bracelet stacked beside the watch, gold-framed aviator sunglasses with brown gradient lenses, fitted Brazilian football jerseys worn slightly too short over his rounded belly, premium sneakers that somehow stay spotless despite São Paulo's streets, and designer shorts or tailored linen trousers depending on the occasion, usually coloured in a Miami-skyline-inspired colour palette.

Everything about him says "money." Everything else says "questionable taste."

Personality

The Vibe

Ciko is impossible to dislike. He's charismatic, relaxed and effortlessly social. He speaks slowly but with a deep cigarette voice that amplifies the south SP accent, laughs often and greets everyone like an old friend.

He loves: football, churrasco, caipirinhas, luxury watches, expensive sunglasses, rooftop parties, betting on football, loud music, arriving fashionably late, picking up the tab for the last tequila round at sunrise.

He's the kind of character who'll spend R$20,000 on a necklace while negotiating over the price of parking.

Lifestyle

The Circuit

His day usually begins around noon. Coffee is never made at home, Ciko's natural habitat is the grey zone where celebrity culture, football money, and São Paulo tech wealth overlap. He can be both at a product launch he was not exactly invited to, or a high profile boxing event, at tables in Fogo de Chão (he definitely booked himself), and courtside at Corinthians matches in seats that raise eyebrows. He knows everyone and everyone knows him, though nobody can quite explain what he does.

Nobody has ever actually seen Ciko working.

Afternoons are spent wandering around Faria Lima, Itaim Bibi, Vila Olímpia and Jardins. He's frequently spotted outside luxury hotels, valet parking stands, football training centres, high-end shopping malls, exclusive gyms, rooftop restaurants, poker tournaments and VIP lounges.

Rumours about his business ventures change weekly. Real estate. Crypto. Sports betting. Nightclubs. Import-export. Consulting. Nobody knows. He certainly isn't telling.

Catchphrases
Relax, irmão... it'll work out.
Money comes and goes. Gold stays.
Connections are worth more than cash.
Bro, I know the owner.
Quirks

Never removes his sunglasses, even indoors. Carries two phones. Tips valet attendants generously. Knows every doorman by name. Somehow gets into invitation-only events without an invitation. Takes selfies with famous people but never asks for them. Orders sparkling water in meetings to look "professional." Loves talking about watches more than telling the time.

Visual Style

Imagine a blend of: Brazilian football culture, São Paulo luxury nightlife, old-money aspirations mixed with new-money confidence, flashy 2000s hip-hop jewellery, luxury streetwear, effortless capybara calm.

Despite the mountain of gold and designer clothing, Ciko never looks stressed. That's his greatest flex.

He has the laid-back confidence of someone who behaves as though he belongs everywhere and, somehow, usually does.

"If people can hear your jewellery before they see you, you've dressed correctly."
— Ciko, Capymillions
